claim: exact identities of enumerated repository-local Gen17 controls and frozen critical workflow shape replay
limitations: no upstream action or package authenticity claim
GitHub-hosted runner image, Python patch, pip, index, and network are not content-addressed
hash-locked install is not an offline wheel mirror or rebuild proof
lock solving is not claimed deterministic or reproducible from requirements-ci.in
co-edited inputs and manifest require an independently accepted commit/receipt identity
no hermeticity, SBOM, SLSA, product-readiness, launch-authority, or scientific claim
enumerated controls are not whole-tree identity; that requires the accepted source commit

run_commands: test -n "${RUNNER_TEMP:-}" && test -d "${RUNNER_TEMP}" && test ! -L "${RUNNER_TEMP}" && test ! -e "${RUNNER_TEMP}/sentinel-ci-${{ matrix.python-version }}" && python -I -B -m venv "${RUNNER_TEMP}/sentinel-ci-${{ matrix.python-version }}"

test ! -e "${RUNNER_TEMP}/sentinel-ci-install-${{ matrix.python-version }}.json" && "${RUNNER_TEMP}/sentinel-ci-${{ matrix.python-version }}/bin/python" -I -B -m pip --isolated --disable-pip-version-check install --no-input --force-reinstall --require-hashes --only-binary=':all:' --no-deps --report "${RUNNER_TEMP}/sentinel-ci-install-${{ matrix.python-version }}.json" -r ${{ matrix.lock }}

command "${RUNNER_TEMP}/sentinel-ci-${{ matrix.python-version }}/bin/python" -I -B -S tools/ci/verify_ci_install.py --python-minor "${{ matrix.python-version }}" --lock "${{ matrix.lock }}" --report "${RUNNER_TEMP}/sentinel-ci-install-${{ matrix.python-version }}.json"

env -u PYTHONHOME -u PYTHONOPTIMIZE -u PYTEST_ADDOPTS -u PYTEST_PLUGINS PYTHONPATH= PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 "${RUNNER_TEMP}/sentinel-ci-${{ matrix.python-version }}/bin/python" -B -S tools/ci/run_pytest_isolated.py -q -c pyproject.toml --noconftest --strict-config --strict-markers tests/test_iter135_gen17_ci_hardening.py tests/test_iter135_ci_install_verifier.py

env -u PYTHONHOME -u PYTHONOPTIMIZE -u PYTEST_ADDOPTS -u PYTEST_PLUGINS PYTHONPATH= PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 "${RUNNER_TEMP}/sentinel-ci-${{ matrix.python-version }}/bin/python" -B -S tools/ci/run_pytest_isolated.py -q -c pyproject.toml --noconftest --strict-config --strict-markers
